faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about KAMBRIQ and our services.

q1.question: How do I buy land from abroad?
q1.answer: Buying from abroad is done in 4 simple steps: browse our available lands, select the land and request a virtual tour, our local team verifies and sends you all documents, then secure electronic signature and fund transfer via our banking partner.

q2.question: What documents come with each land?
q2.answer: Each land sold via KAMBRIQ comes with: certified title deed, KAMBRIQ Verify certificate, official cadastral plan, expert surveyor boundary report, non-dispute certificate, and complete transaction history.

q3.question: What do the KAMBRIQ TFL™, VEFL™ and VEFIL™ labels mean?
q3.answer: These are KAMBRIQ's 3 security levels. KAMBRIQ TFL™: the land already has an individual title deed — maximum security. KAMBRIQ VEFL™: a parent title deed exists, subdivision is underway. KAMBRIQ VEFIL™: the land is on the national domain, the registration process is pending or underway — higher risk, reinforced support.

q4.question: What is KAMBRIQ VERIFY™?
q4.answer: Our land verification service. 7 control points per land: title authenticity, owner identity, known disputes, geographic accuracy, technical file, legal status, transaction history. €99 for external verification, free if you buy through KAMBRIQ.

q5.question: How do I become a certified KAMNET Agent?
q5.answer: By completing the KCA certification through KAMBRIQ Business School (KBS). Online training, final exam (QCM, minimum score 85%), numbered certificate valid for 2 years. More info on the KBS page.

landTypes.title: Our 3 labels
landTypes.subtitle: Every land receives a KAMBRIQ label that clearly indicates its legal status

tfl.name: KAMBRIQ TFL™ — Titre Foncier Loti
tfl.description: The land has an individual title deed established. Immediate transaction possible. The highest level of security.

advantages.client: You become the owner upon notarial signature. No additional administrative procedures.
advantages.agent: Fast commission, simplified process, secured client.
advantages.commitment: Authentic title deed verified by KAMBRIQ VERIFY™, cadastral compliance confirmed.

vefl.name: KAMBRIQ VEFL™ — Vente en État Futur de Lotissement
vefl.description: A parent title deed exists. The land is being subdivided to obtain an individual title.

advantages.client: The parent title secures your purchase. You will receive an individual title once subdivision is complete. Shorter timelines than VEFIL™.
advantages.commitment: Parent title verified by KAMBRIQ VERIFY™, approved subdivision plan, KAMBRIQ milestone tracking.

vefil.name: KAMBRIQ VEFIL™ — Vente en État Futur d'Immatriculation et de Lotissement
vefil.description: The land is on national domain. It does not yet have a title deed. The registration process is underway or to be initiated.

advantages.client: You are NOT the owner upon signing. You become the owner once land registration is complete. More attractive price, higher risk.
advantages.agent: Long-term accompaniment, strong client retention potential.
advantages.commitment: Additional verification milestones required by KAMBRIQ. Full monitoring of the registration process.
